title: Supply and Installation of Router e-office for Deep Bhavan, Chennai
summary: E-tender for supply and installation of a router for e-office at Deep Bhavan, the Chennai office of the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffar Syrang Street, Chennai
sites.work: Supply and installation of router for e-office

scope.item: Supply and installation of router for e-office

money.notes: Tender fee (non-refundable) and EMD by DD/FDR/bank guarantee of any nationalised/scheduled bank in favour of Director, Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai; originals by end of bid submission period.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of commercial bid opening

eligibility: Reputed OEMs or authorized dealers of OEMs, licensed contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: Section I NIT only (printed pages 3-4); no router specifications or BOQ. The Hindi text (both paragraph and name-of-work row) describes 'supply and installation of CCTV system for Kanyakumari Lighthouse under Chennai Directorate', apparently copied from another tender, while the English text and listing say router for e-office at Deep Bhavan. Download/submission 05.02.2024 17:00 to 26.02.2024 16:00; technical bid opening 27.02.2024 16:00.
